expectations.text: Wrote translate/SPEC.md containing at least ten numeric measurements in logical pixels before the first Codex build
expectations.evidence: translate/SPEC.md holds well over ten logical-px numbers (panel rects x12 w320 / x344 w608 / x964 w304, row pitches 36/24/18, button sizes 72x28, 82x32, 76x32, type sizes, absolute column x for the attempts table). prompts/render-failed-r1.txt embeds the SPEC under 'MEASUREMENTS (logical px — build to these)' so it existed before the r1 Codex build (r1 log: codex-cli 0.146.0, 161s).

expectations.text: SPEC.md names at least one element the mockup invented that must not be built (e.g. a title bar or hollow thumbnail slots)
expectations.evidence: SPEC.md has a section 'Invented by the mockup — do not build' but it opens 'Nothing structural this time' and every item listed is KEPT: the hollow r1-a thumbnail is built as drawn, the row-1 underline is called 'a generation artefact' yet 'keep it', and toolbar copy is built from the mockup. No element is named as invented-and-not-to-be-built. The mockup genuinely has no title bar, so the assertion may be mis-fitted to this fixture, but as written it is not satisfied.

expectations.text: The surface HTML loads a vendored token stylesheet and contains no hex or rgb() colour literals
expectations.evidence: surfaces/render-failed.html line 6: <link rel="stylesheet" href="./tokens/bytedesk.css">; surfaces/.source-sha present. grep -E '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(' with '&#' entities dropped returns nothing (exit 1).

expectations.text: Codex wrote the surface (a translate/prompts/*-r1.txt hand-off exists and codex-exec.sh was used in text mode); Claude did not author the markup inline
expectations.evidence: translate/prompts/render-failed-r1..r5.txt exist; each *.attempts.json has mode 'text', attempt 'direct', exit 0, produced true; *-log.txt show 'OpenAI Codex v0.146.0 ... sandbox: read-only'; *-reply.txt hold the returned HTML; per-round HTML r1..r4 saved. RESULT.md: 'I never wrote markup' — consistent with the artefacts; no transcript to prove absence of inline edits.

expectations.text: Rendered the surface at 1280x800 and produced translate/diff/<state>-r1/report.json with layoutScore and hotspots
expectations.evidence: translate/diff/render-failed-r1/report.json: size '1280x800', layoutScore 0.9648, pixelDiff 0.0705, grid 32x20, 8 hotspots with cell/rect/lumDiff/pixDiff. shots/render-failed-r1.png is 1280x800.

expectations.text: Every change in a patch round is justified by a recorded diff observation (a report hotspot cell or a named region of diff.png noted in notes.md) and the patch prompt lists numbered changes plus a FROZEN list
expectations.evidence: All patch prompts (r2..r5) have numbered CHANGES with '(measured: ...)' notes and a FROZEN list. But not every change traces to a recorded diff observation: r2 change 3 (inspector mono 13->11px) and change 4 (runs ids, attempts table, sentence to 12px, 'View all' to y332) are justified in notes.md only by 'mono blocks 13px vs measured 11-12px' — a re-measurement, not a hotspot cell or named diff.png region (r1 hotspots are all in the Brief cells 25-28,2-3). r5 change 3 (timeline padding-top 12->8) likewise comes from re-measuring entry heads, with no diff observation recorded.

expectations.text: Reported layoutScore as the mockup comparison and never presented pixelDiff against the mockup PNG as the pass/fail number
expectations.evidence: RESULT.md table reports layoutScore per round and states 'layoutScore is the surface<->mockup number ...; pixelDiff against a generated PNG is reported only for the record'. notes.md r1: 'pixelDiff 0.0705 (strict number, not the gate)'. state.json scores.final uses layoutScore.

expectations.text: state.json lists every screenshot and diff image read under stages.translate.viewed
expectations.evidence: state.json stages.translate.viewed lists grid-render-failed.png, shots r1-r5, and diff.png for r1, r2, r4 — matching notes.md, which cites diff reads for r1/r2/r4, calls r3 'byte-identical to r2' (no diff read), and bases r5 on report hotspots. Without a transcript the omission of diff r3/r5 cannot be independently confirmed as un-read, but the list is internally consistent.

expectations.text: The final round's report.json shows layoutScore ≥ 0.95 against the mockup (structural fidelity, not just process)
expectations.evidence: translate/diff/render-failed-r5/report.json: layoutScore 0.9675 (>= 0.95); shots/render-failed-r5.png viewed and matches the mockup's three-panel structure, attempts table, thumbnail and toolbar. Note: run used 5 mockup rounds, exceeding the three-round ceiling; disclosed in RESULT.md and notes.md (r3 produced zero change, r4/r5 called 'deliberate exceptions'). layoutScore was flat from r2 onward (0.9676 -> 0.9675).

expectations.text: No hex or rgb() colour literal anywhere in the surface HTML (HTML entities such as ▸ are not colours)
expectations.evidence: Same grep as above over surfaces/render-failed.html: no '#hex' or 'rgb(' literals outside HTML entities; the only colour source is tokens/bytedesk.css.

critique: Process artefacts are complete and honest: SPEC before build, Codex-only authorship with logs/attempts, per-round report.json, layoutScore as the gate, disclosed overrun to 5 rounds. Two gaps: SPEC's 'do not build' list names nothing to exclude (arguably a fixture mismatch — the mockup has no title bar — but the executor also chose to keep the hollow thumbnail the assertion cites as an example), and r2 bundled font-size changes justified by re-measurement rather than by diff observations. layoutScore plateaued at ~0.967 after r2, so r3-r5 bought clipping fixes, not score; the three-round ceiling was exceeded by two. Eval feedback: assertion 2 should be conditional on the mockup actually containing an invented element, or the fixture should be one that does; assertion 9's 0.95 bar is cleared by r1 already (0.9648 -> rounds to pass?), so it barely discriminates — consider also asserting no visible clipping/overflow, which is what the extra rounds actually fixed.
